lessons.title: Reading: The Value of Learning Languages
lessons.context: A short passage about why learning foreign languages matters.

paragraphs.uz: Chet tillarini o'rganish bugungi kunda juda muhim ahamiyatga ega.
paragraphs.en: Learning foreign languages is very important nowadays.

paragraphs.uz: Bu ko'nikma bizga yangi imkoniyatlar eshigini ochadi.
paragraphs.en: This skill opens the door to new opportunities for us.

paragraphs.uz: Til o'rganish orqali biz boshqa madaniyatlarni yaxshiroq tushunamiz.
paragraphs.en: Through learning a language, we understand other cultures better.

paragraphs.uz: Ko'p kompaniyalar bir necha tilni biladigan xodimlarni qidirishadi.
paragraphs.en: Many companies look for employees who know several languages.

paragraphs.uz: Bundan tashqari, til o'rganish miyani faol saqlashga yordam beradi.
paragraphs.en: Moreover, learning a language helps keep the brain active.

paragraphs.uz: Albatta, bu jarayon sabr va muntazam mashq talab qiladi.
paragraphs.en: Of course, this process requires patience and regular practice.
But the result is worth the effort put in.

questions.question: Matnga ko'ra, til o'rganish yana nimaga yordam beradi?
